```{r}
#| label: setup

# Loading Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)

# Loading Data
data <- readRDS("../data/processed/imvigor210_prepared.rds")
expr <- data$tpm
metadata <- data$clinical
```

```{r}
#| label: align-samples

# Check that all patient IDs are present in the expression matrix
stopifnot(all(metadata$pat_id %in% colnames(expr)))

# Reorder expression columns to match the metadata
expr <- expr[, match(metadata$pat_id, colnames(expr)), drop = FALSE]

# Verify that sample order is identical
stopifnot(identical(as.character(metadata$pat_id), colnames(expr)))

# Check the response distribution
table(metadata$BOR, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}

#| label: extract-tmb-pd1

# Tumor mutational burden
TMB <- metadata$TMB

# Confirm that PDCD1 is present in the expression matrix
stopifnot("PDCD1" %in% rownames(expr))

# Extract and log-transform PDCD1 expression
PD1 <- log2(as.numeric(expr["PDCD1", ]) + 1)

summary(TMB)
summary(PD1)
```

```{r}

#| label: calculate-gep

GEP_genes <- c(
  "CD27", "CD274", "PDCD1", "CD276",
  "CD8A", "CMKLR1", "CXCL9", "CXCR6",
  "HLA-DQA1", "HLA-DRB1", "HLA-E",
  "IDO1", "LAG3", "NKG7", "PDCD1LG2",
  "PSMB10", "STAT1", "TIGIT"
)

# Check which genes are present
GEP_genes_present <- GEP_genes[GEP_genes %in% rownames(expr)]
GEP_genes_missing <- setdiff(GEP_genes, rownames(expr))

cat("GEP genes present:", length(GEP_genes_present), "\n")
cat("Missing genes:", paste(GEP_genes_missing, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Extract and log-transform the available GEP genes
GEP_expr <- log2(
  expr[GEP_genes_present, , drop = FALSE] + 1
)

# Standardize each gene across patients
GEP_expr_scaled <- t(scale(t(GEP_expr)))

# Calculate one GEP score per patient
GEP_scores <- colMeans(GEP_expr_scaled, na.rm = TRUE)

summary(GEP_scores)
```

```{r}
#| label: create-analysis-data-and-test-response-biomarkers

# Combining biomarkers
df <- data.frame(
  sample = metadata$pat_id,
  TMB = TMB,
  PD1 = PD1,
  GEP_scores = GEP_scores,
  BOR = factor(metadata$BOR, levels = c("NR", "R"))
)

stopifnot(identical(df$sample, colnames(expr)))

# Tests
TMB_test <- wilcox.test(TMB ~ BOR, data = df, exact = FALSE)
PD1_test <- wilcox.test(PD1 ~ BOR, data = df, exact = FALSE)
GEP_test <- wilcox.test(GEP_scores ~ BOR, data = df, exact = FALSE)

TMB_test
PD1_test
GEP_test
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-response-biomarkers

plot_Response_boxplot <- function(data, variable, y_label, test_result) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = BOR, y = .data[[variable]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.6) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = Inf,
      label = paste0("p = ", signif(test_result$p.value, 3)),
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Treatment response",
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

```{r}
#| label: TMB-distribution-plot
plot_Response_boxplot(
  df,
  "TMB",
  "Tumor mutational burden (mut/Mb)",
  TMB_test
)
```

```{r}
#| label: PDCD1-expression-distribution-plot

plot_Response_boxplot(
  df,
  "PD1",
  "PDCD1 expression",
  PD1_test
)
```

```{r}
#| label: T-cell-inflamed-GEP-distribution-plot

plot_Response_boxplot(
  df,
  "GEP_scores",
  "T-cell-inflamed GEP score",
  GEP_test
)
```

```{r}
#| label: compare-biomarkers

df |>
  group_by(BOR) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_TMB = median(TMB, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_PD1 = median(PD1, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_GEP = median(GEP_scores, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
